# cleanup

macOS disk reclamation: estimate first, then purge caches by category behind an explicit confirmation. Merges the old `clean.sh` estimator with the unguarded cache removals that used to live in `ai.sh`.

---

## `cleanup_all`

Run the full reclamation: print the estimate, then walk each category. Every category asks before it touches anything, so any prompt can be declined without aborting the rest.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Chains every destructive function in this module.

**Usage**

```sh
cleanup_all
```

**Examples**

```sh
cleanup_all
```

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/cleanup.sh:262`](../../modules/darwin/cleanup.sh#L262)

**See also** `cleanup_estimate`, `cleanup_purge_ai`, `cleanup_purge_dev`, `cleanup_purge_apps`, `cleanup_purge_vm`

---

## `cleanup_estimate`

Audit reclaimable disk space without deleting anything. Lists every cache path this module knows about, plus the Homebrew cache and Docker's reported artefact size.

**Usage**

```sh
cleanup_estimate
```

**Examples**

```sh
cleanup_estimate
```

**Requires** `du`

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/cleanup.sh:119`](../../modules/darwin/cleanup.sh#L119)

**See also** `cleanup_all`

## `cleanup_purge_ai`

Purge AI tooling caches: Hugging Face, Ollama, Claude Desktop's updater cache, and optionally the multi-gigabyte Claude VM bundle.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Deletes model and VM data. The Claude VM bundle is several GB and is gated behind its own second confirmation.

**Usage**

```sh
cleanup_purge_ai
```

**Examples**

```sh
cleanup_purge_ai
```

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/cleanup.sh:162`](../../modules/darwin/cleanup.sh#L162)

**See also** `cleanup_estimate`, `cleanup_purge_hf`

---

## `cleanup_purge_apps`

Purge application and browser caches, plus the Homebrew download cache after running `brew cleanup`.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Deletes cached application data and every downloaded Homebrew bottle.

**Usage**

```sh
cleanup_purge_apps
```

**Examples**

```sh
cleanup_purge_apps
```

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/cleanup.sh:208`](../../modules/darwin/cleanup.sh#L208)

## `cleanup_purge_dev`

Purge developer toolchain caches: uv, pip, go, npm, bun, swiftpm, Jedi, goimports, and the Python bytecode cache.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Empties package manager caches. Next build re-downloads everything.

**Usage**

```sh
cleanup_purge_dev
```

**Examples**

```sh
cleanup_purge_dev
```

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/cleanup.sh:189`](../../modules/darwin/cleanup.sh#L189)

---

## `cleanup_purge_hf`

Purge Hugging Face caches. Removes the xet chunk cache outright and hands the model hub to `hf cache delete`, which prompts for which repos to drop.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Deletes downloaded model data. Re-downloading is slow and metered.

**Usage**

```sh
cleanup_purge_hf
```

**Examples**

```sh
cleanup_purge_hf
```

**Requires** `hf`

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/cleanup.sh:149`](../../modules/darwin/cleanup.sh#L149)

---

## `cleanup_purge_vm`

Prune virtualization artefacts: unused Docker images, containers, networks and build cache, then Lima instance leftovers.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Removes every unused Docker image and container. Docker volumes are only touched after a separate confirmation — they hold real data.

**Usage**

```sh
cleanup_purge_vm
```

**Examples**

```sh
CLEANUP_DOCKER_VOLUMES=1 cleanup_purge_vm
```

**Requires** (`docker` or `limactl`)

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/cleanup.sh:233`](../../modules/darwin/cleanup.sh#L233)
